mapper.select: SELECT card_id,revision,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,status,changed_by,changed_at FROM knowledge_card_revisions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} ORDER BY revision DESC
SELECT card_id,revision,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,status,changed_by,changed_at FROM knowledge_card_revisions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET title=#{source.title},card_type=#{source.cardType},content=#{source.content},tags=#{source.tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler},status='DRAFT',revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,status,revision,created_at,updated_at FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId}
